title: Extend the token scale in styles.css instead of repeating a magic number
statement: When a needed value (a spacing step, a control height, a radius) does not yet exist as a `--studio-*` token, add it once to `:root` in `frontend/src/styles.css` and consume it everywhere; do not copy the same raw literal into two or more component stylesheets.
rationale: A value repeated across files with no shared source is a de facto ad-hoc token nobody can find or rename; the next change to it means a repo-wide grep instead of a one-line edit. `styles.css` already centralizes `--studio-control-hit-compact`, `--studio-textarea-min-height` and similar app-specific sizes for exactly this reason.

good.caption: One named token, consumed wherever the value is needed.

bad.caption: The same hit-target height copied by value into three unrelated stylesheets.

changelog.summary: Initial rule, complementing QS-NG-003 with the duplicate-magic-number angle of the same defect class.
